instruction: Extract all files of a specific size range from image
output: fls -o 2048 -r image.dd | awk '$4 >= 100000 && $4 <= 500000 {print $2}' | tr -d ':' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'icat -o 2048 image.dd {} > /tmp/extracted/{}'
